interpretation.strong_load: R3 uses LC_LOAD_DYLIB, not LC_LOAD_WEAK_DYLIB; required compatibility version is 1.0.0. B has no direct errno dylib load. Both frozen shipping artifacts have minos 15.0.
interpretation.symbol: R3 references the Darwin.errno getter _$s6Darwin5errnos5Int32Vvg from libswift_errno.
interpretation.macos_15_to_25: SDK _DarwinFoundation1 metadata redirects errno getter/setter/modify symbols to libswift_errno for platform 1 minimum versions >=15.0 and <26.0.
interpretation.older_targets: libswift_errno.tbd redirects the install name to libswiftDarwin for macOS >=10.14.4 and <15.0, with an older @rpath route for >=10.9 and <10.14.4.
interpretation.range_semantics: Apple ld64 generic_dylib_file.cpp rejects a previous-location directive when minimum OS is below start or >=end; start inclusive, end exclusive.
interpretation.compatibility_version: The recorded current-version 428.40.1 is library-version metadata; the executable compatibility requirement is 1.0.0, not a macOS version.

package_availability.behavior: Normal source package defines SYSTEM_PACKAGE and uses source availability macOS 10.10; macOS 26 platform declarations are under SYSTEM_ABI_STABLE and do not set the normal SystemPackage deployment floor.

primary_sources.purpose: Official Apple linker implementation of previous-location range and install-name overrides.
